theorem prop_32_full {X G : Type*} [Group G] :
    (∀ (c : Connection X G) (g : X → G) (x y : X), (c.rename g).U x y = g x * c.U x y * (g y)⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ (c : Connection X G) (g : X → G) (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) = x →
      hol (c.rename g) (x :: rest) = g x * hol c (x :: rest) * (g x)⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ {n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) = x →
      IsFact (fun c : Connection X (Matrix n n R)ˣ =>
        ((hol c (x :: rest) : (Matrix n n R)ˣ) : Matrix n n R).trace)) ∧
    (∀ (c : Connection X G) (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) ≠ x →
      ∀ V : G, ∃ g : X → G, hol (c.rename g) (x :: rest) = V) ∧
    (∀ {α : Type*} (φ : G → α) (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) ≠ x →
      IsFact (fun c : Connection X G => φ (hol c (x :: rest))) → ∀ V W : G, φ V = φ W)

theorem prop_19 :

      halfOf P * halfOf P = (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ∧
      (halfOf P)ᵀ * halfOf P = (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ∧
      (halfOf P)ᴴ * halfOf P = 1 ∧ halfOf P ^ 4 = 1 ∧
      halfOf P * halfOf (1 - P) = Complex.I • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ), P * P = P →
      (1 - P + Complex.I • P) * (1 - P + Complex.I • P) = 1 - (2 : ℂ) • P ∧
      (Pᴴ = P → (1 - P + Complex.I • P)ᴴ * (1 - P + Complex.I • P) = 1)) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ), P * P = P → P ≠ 0 → P ≠ 1 →
      ∀ α β : ℂ, ((α • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + β • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)) ^ 2 =
          (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ↔
        α • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + β • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ∈
          ({halfOf P, -halfOf P, (halfOf P).map star, -(halfOf P).map star} :
            Set (Matrix n n ℂ)))) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ), P * P = P → P ≠ 0 → P ≠ 1 →
      ∀ α β : ℝ, ((α : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + (β : ℂ) • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)) ^ 2 ≠
        (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)) ∧
    (∀ P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, Pᵀ = P → P * P = P → ∀ v : Fin 6 → ℝ,
      metricOf P v = ((∑ a, ((1 - P) *ᵥ v) a ^ 2 - ∑ a, (P *ᵥ v) a ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6), halfOf (Matrix.diagonal fun a => if a ∈ D then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = half D) ∧
    (∀ D S : Finset (Fin 6),

lean.name: Comparison.System.prop_203
lean.statement:
theorem prop_203 (h : Fin 5) (a₀ s₀ : State) (h₀ : Continues a₀ s₀) :
    (∀ (s : State) (a : Fin 5), a ≠ s.2 →
      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 5 × Fin 5 × Fin 5)).filter fun q =>
        q.1 ≠ a ∧ q.2.1 ≠ q.1 ∧ q.2.2 ≠ q.2.1 ∧
          RuleAndLaw.stepAlong (RuleAndLaw.stepAlong (RuleAndLaw.stepAlong (RuleAndLaw.stepAlong s a) q.1) q.2.1) q.2.2 = s) = {(s.2, a, s.2)}) ∧
    (∀ {a t : Fin 5}, a ≠ t → γ t * γ a * γ t * γ a = -1) ∧
    (B ℚ ^ 4).trace = 320 ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 5, star Ω ⬝ᵥ ((L + γ h ⊗ₖ γ t) *ᵥ Ω) = 6 + if t = h then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ (p q : State), Continues q p → ∀ z u : ℂ,
      (1 - u • WholePicture.Bmark p q z).det =
        WholePicture.lawPoly.eval u + (z - 1) * u * (Polynomial.derivative WholePicture.lawPoly).eval u / 320) ∧
    (zS sHere = 1 ∧ minor carriedC sHere sHere = 1 ∧ ‖uS sHere‖ / 80 = 1 / 320 ∧
      piU ⬝ᵥ (hadPow ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • B ℝ) (oneTransitionX a₀ s₀) 1 *ᵥ 1) = 1 / 320 ∧
      piU ⬝ᵥ (hadPow ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • B ℝ) (availableTransitionsLawX h (transitionX h)) 1 *ᵥ 1) = 1836 / 320) ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix State State ℝ,
      piU ⬝ᵥ (hadPow ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • B ℝ) X 1 *ᵥ 1) =
        (1 / 320) * ∑ s : State, ∑ s' : State, (if Continues s s' then X s' s else 0) ∧
      ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 0, charF ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • B ℝ) X s (ψ s) = 0) ∧
        HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => Complex.arg (ψ (-I * θ)))
          (-(piU ⬝ᵥ (hadPow ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • B ℝ) X 1 *ᵥ 1))) 0) ∧
    (∀ X : State → State → ℕ, 0 < GroupsContinuumLaw.natTotal X →
      (1 : ℚ) / 320 ≤ GroupsContinuumLaw.rate (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ)) ∧
      (GroupsContinuumLaw.rate (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ)) = 1 / 320 ↔
        ∃ e ∈ Comparison.arcs, X e.2 e.1 = 1 ∧ ∀ f ∈ Comparison.arcs, f ≠ e → X f.2 f.1 = 0))
